nt2e21.title: Cancer Frames a Text
nt2e21.caption:
Cancer got a same-day reply and had it framed. Then someone remembered the talk with their mom, and the frame quietly hit the floor.
What tiny thing did you once treat like a proposal?

nt2e22.title: Leo Gets a Thumbs-Up
nt2e22.caption: One like on a photo and Leo is already thanking the academy. The person who saved a front-row seat at the recital, though? That's the real standing ovation.

nt2e23.title: Libra Gets Asked
nt2e23.caption: Being asked where to eat should not require a parade. Libra threw one anyway. Then Gemini booked the place Libra mentioned once, in July. Tag your listener.

nt2e24.title: Virgo Grades a Text
nt2e24.caption: A period at the end of a text earned a gold star. Seven o'clock-ish earned an A+. A whole plan made for them? Virgo dropped the clipboard. Which grade would your last date get?

nt2e25.title: Aquarius Gets a Good Morning
nt2e25.caption: Aquarius commissioned a statue for a good-morning text. Fair. Then Sagittarius asked to hear the whole theory, all night, and the bar went straight to the ceiling.

nt2e26.title: Taurus and the Last Dumpling
nt2e26.caption: Not sharing fries with someone who said they weren't hungry: valid. The slow stare over the last dumpling: a little petty. Missing your cozy night: valid, so say it out loud.

nt2e27.title: Gemini Renames a Contact
nt2e27.caption: Saving them in your phone as Mr. Late is petty, and Gemini knows it. Wanting someone to ask about your day is not. Which one have you done this week?

nt2e28.title: Scorpio's Dramatic Exit
nt2e28.caption: Scorpio remembers what you wore on date one, swept out of the room in a cape (to the kitchen), and still wants to know where this is going. Two out of three, honestly.

nt2e29.title: Capricorn Sends Minutes
nt2e29.caption: Capricorn wrote meeting notes about a tiny argument and sent them. Petty, beautifully formatted. The real ask was simpler: please plan something for once.

nt2e30.title: Sagittarius Posts a Quote
nt2e30.caption: The vague quote about freedom after a small bicker? Petty. Needing a night alone? Valid. Wanting your big plan taken seriously? Very valid, so tell them. Which sign posts the quote in your group chat?

nt2e31.title: Aries Is Not Cold
nt2e31.caption: "I'm not even cold," says the Aries, shivering, clearly hoping for your jacket. Then they skip the act and just say it: I like you, a lot. Who's your shivering Aries?

nt2e32.title: Scorpio Says Fine
nt2e32.caption: When a Scorpio says fine, it has usually been thinking about it for nine hours. When it says interesting, it is obsessed. When it asks where you're going, believe it.

nt2e33.title: Pisces Is Not Crying
nt2e33.caption: Pisces is not crying. Pisces is crying, because the song is nice. Pisces has also already imagined your whole winter together. Tell us you know a Pisces without telling us.

nt2e34.title: Capricorn Is Just Busy
nt2e34.caption: "Just busy this week" means Friday is already cleared for you. "Let's be practical" means the plant has a name. Capricorn's heart was never off the clock.

nt2e35.title: Aquarius Is Not a Romance Person
nt2e35.caption: "Not really a romance person," says the Aquarius who drew you a star map by hand. Translation available on request. Which line has an air sign said to you?

nt2e36.title: The Taurus Nests
nt2e36.caption: Observed in the cold months: a Taurus gathering every blanket in the house and guarding the snacks with one eye open. The rare part is the sharing, and it was caught on film.

nt2e37.title: The Gemini in the Wild
nt2e37.caption: Here we see the Gemini, keeping three conversations in the air at once. Its call: wait, what? And then, very rarely, it lands and listens. Narrated as quietly as possible.

nt2e38.title: The Cancer Hosts
nt2e38.caption: The Cancer builds a shell of pillows and feeds every visitor. Every one. What the cameras almost never catch: someone bringing the Cancer a cookie for once. Who hosts your friend group?

nt2e39.title: The Sagittarius Roams
nt2e39.caption: Pacing at dawn. Bolting after a new idea. And then, rarely seen, coming back with a second backpack for someone. The wild Sagittarius in its natural habitat.

nt2e40.title: The Libra Decides
nt2e40.caption: Two menus. Forty minutes. A poll of the entire herd, split evenly. Then someone asks what the Libra wants, and it answers instantly. Be the person who asks.
